description: This file defines the control panel configuration for a Superset plugin chart, specifically for a table visualization. It includes control definitions, visibility logic, validation, and layout for various chart options.

methods.name: getQueryMode
methods.description: Determines the current query mode based on control states.

methods.name: isQueryMode
methods.description: Returns a function that checks if the current control state matches a specific query mode.

methods.name: validateAggControlValues
methods.description: Validates that aggregation controls have values when in aggregate mode.

methods.name: generateComparisonColumns
methods.description: Generates comparison column names for a given column.

methods.name: generateComparisonColumnTypes
methods.description: Generates data types for comparison columns.

methods.name: processComparisonColumns
methods.description: Processes columns to generate comparison columns with labels and values.
